briefing: A gang has been taking ships on the lane out of {HERE}, and this station has had enough of it.
My name is {PATRON}, and I run this station. Four raiders hunt together: a Fer-de-Lance leads an Asp, a Krait and a Mamba.
Find them near the lane and finish every one. The leader may run once it takes damage, so don't let up.
